---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea for Comis
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem

What problem does this feature solve? (e.g., "I'm frustrated when...")

## Proposed Solution

How you would like this to work.

## Alternatives Considered

Other approaches you have thought about.

## Affected Area

Select the user-facing area that best matches the request. It is fine to choose
"Not sure."

- [ ] Agent behavior or workflows
- [ ] Context, memory, or governed learning
- [ ] Execution, delegation, limits, or recovery
- [ ] Identity, credentials, security, or privacy
- [ ] Incident evidence or explanation
- [ ] Messaging channel
- [ ] Models, tools, MCP, media, or another integration
- [ ] CLI or dashboard
- [ ] Installation, deployment, or operations
- [ ] Documentation or contributor experience
- [ ] Not sure

## Success Criteria

What observable behavior would tell you that this request is complete? Include
the tested profile and residual risk when the result depends on an operating
system, isolation mode, provider, model, tool profile, or existing learned
state.

If the idea is best expressed as a workload, public attack path, learning
failure, or integration result, use the
[Open Evidence Proposal](https://github.com/comisai/comis/issues/new?template=open_evidence.md)
template instead. Report unpatched vulnerabilities privately through
[SECURITY.md](https://github.com/comisai/comis/security/policy).

## Additional Context

Any other context, mockups, or examples.
